params.body:
## What

Every page title on hoet.be ends in **" - Hoet"**, once. The home page is the one exception: there the brand goes first.

Until now titles ended four ways, depending on where they came from:

| page | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| home | Hoet - Onopvallend opvallende brillen | Hoet - Onopvallend opvallende brillen |
| faq | Veelgestelde vragen — Hoet | Veelgestelde vragen - Hoet |
| news | Nieuws \| Hoet Eyewear | Nieuws - Hoet |
| frame | HOET COUTURE F2 | Couture F2 - Hoet |
| contact | Neem contact op met Hoet | Contact - Hoet |
| privacy | Privacybeleid — Hoet | Privacybeleid - Hoet |

**Frames take their title from the Studio.** A frame reads `seo.metaTitle`, `seo.metaDescription` and `seo.ogImage` (the new SEO field in hoet-sanity) in its own language. An empty field falls back to what the site derives: the line and the model ("Couture F2", no longer in capitals), and the material description as before. There is no fallback to the Dutch SEO text, because a Dutch sentence on `/en` is worse than the derived English title.

## How

`App\Support\PageTitle` builds the title in the layout, so `<title>`, `og:title` and `twitter:title` are the same:

- `make()` takes a brand typed at the front or the end off first ("Hoet - …", "… — Hoet", "… | Hoet Eyewear"), then appends " - Hoet". Titles already in the Studio therefore do not get the brand twice. A brand inside a title ("Hoet Couture — …") stays, because it is part of a name. The Studio warns about those instead.
- `home()` puts the brand in front. A title typed as "Hoet - …" stays as it is.

The controllers no longer add a brand themselves (journal, faq, contact, Couture², configurator tab). The error pages, which stand alone, end in " - Hoet" as well. Translation keys follow: "Neem contact op met Hoet" and "Veelgestelde vragen — Hoet" are gone, and "Veelgestelde vragen" is new.

## Checked

- Full suite: 474 tests, 473 pass. `BuildStampTest` fails in any git worktree, also on main. Pint passes.
- New `tests/Feature/PaginaTitelTest.php` covers the titles typed in the Studio on 2026-11-26, home, contact, faq, news, and a frame with and without SEO.

## After merge

Five pages have "Hoet" inside their SEO title, in four languages: Over ons, Couture, Couture², Costume and Verkooppunten. They work, but they show the brand twice until they are retyped without it.
params.title: End every page title in " - Hoet", and let a frame take its title from the Studio
